# Setup

Loads packages for frequency summaries, Bayesian Gompertz fits, and plots, and sets `knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)`.

```{r packages, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(brms)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
```

```{r knitr_options}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)
```

# Load Data

Loads `mandarin_tokens_processed` from the processed Feather file with `speaker`, `age`, `negation_category`, and `negation_scope`. Creates `mandarin_model_dir` for cached models.

```{r processedUtterances}
mandarin_data_dir <- "../mandarin/mandarin_data/processed_data"
mandarin_model_dir <- "../mandarin/mandarin_model/modeling"
dir.create(mandarin_model_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

mandarin_tokens_processed <- read_feather(
  file.path(mandarin_data_dir, "mandarin_tokens_processed.feather"),
  col_select = c(speaker, age, negation_category, negation_scope)
)
```

# Prepare Negator Tokens

Counts `mandarin_tokens_processed` rows by `speaker` and `age` as `mandarin_speaker_age_totals` and selects rows with nonmissing `negation_category` as `mandarin_negator_tokens`.

- Every 不 counts as 不, including 不是, 不要, and 不知道.
- Every 没 or traditional 沒 counts as 没, including 没有 and 沒有.
- A-not-A questions count toward their negator: 是不是 and 好不好 → 不, 有没有 → 没.

```{r negator_tokens}
# Tokens per speaker and month: the denominator for every rate (ages 0-10 set to zero).
mandarin_speaker_age_totals <- mandarin_tokens_processed %>%
  count(speaker, age, name = "total") %>%
  mutate(total = as.numeric(total)) %>%
  complete(speaker = "child", age = 0:10, fill = list(total = 0)) %>%
  mutate(total = if_else(speaker == "child" & age <= 10, 0, total))

# One row per negator token (bu -> 不, mei -> 没).
mandarin_negator_tokens <- mandarin_tokens_processed %>%
  filter(!is.na(negation_category)) %>%
  mutate(word = if_else(negation_category == "bu", "不", "没"))

count(mandarin_negator_tokens, word, negation_scope)
```

# Calculate Relative Frequencies

Calculates monthly and cumulative negation rates using `mandarin_speaker_age_totals` as the denominator. Sets child counts and denominator contributions at ages 0–10 to zero.

## Overall Negation Rates

Calculates monthly `pct` and cumulative `cumulative_pct` for `mandarin_negator_tokens` by `speaker` and `age`. Saves the resulting `mandarin_negation_relfreq` table.

```{r negation_relfreq}
mandarin_negation_relfreq <- mandarin_speaker_age_totals %>%
  left_join(
    count(mandarin_negator_tokens, speaker, age, name = "freq"),
    by = c("speaker", "age")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    freq = replace_na(freq, 0L),
    freq = if_else(speaker == "child" & age <= 10, 0L, freq),
    relfreq = if_else(total == 0, 0, freq / total),
    pct = relfreq * 100
  ) %>%
  group_by(speaker) %>%
  arrange(age, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_freq = cumsum(freq),
    cum_total = cumsum(total),
    cumulative_relfreq = if_else(cum_total == 0, 0, cum_freq / cum_total),
    cumulative_pct = cumulative_relfreq * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

saveRDS(mandarin_negation_relfreq, file.path(mandarin_data_dir, "mandarin_negation_relfreq.RDS"))
```

## Individual Negator Rates

Calculates monthly `ppt` and cumulative `cumulative_ppt` by `word` in `mandarin_functionword_relfreq`. Retains child ages 0–10 and later months with positive counts in each word-specific cumulative denominator.

```{r functionword_relfreq}
mandarin_functionword_relfreq <- mandarin_negator_tokens %>%
  count(word, speaker, age, name = "freq") %>%
  complete(word, speaker = "child", age = 0:10, fill = list(freq = 0L)) %>%
  mutate(freq = if_else(speaker == "child" & age <= 10, 0L, freq)) %>%
  left_join(mandarin_speaker_age_totals, by = c("speaker", "age")) %>%
  mutate(
    total = replace_na(total, 0),
    relfreq = if_else(total == 0, 0, freq / total),
    ppt = relfreq * 1000
  ) %>%
  filter(freq > 0 | (speaker == "child" & age %in% 0:10)) %>%
  group_by(word, speaker) %>%
  arrange(age, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_freq = cumsum(freq),
    cum_total = cumsum(total),
    cumulative_relfreq = if_else(cum_total == 0, 0, cum_freq / cum_total),
    cumulative_ppt = cumulative_relfreq * 1000
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(word, speaker, age, freq, total, relfreq, ppt,
         cum_freq, cum_total, cumulative_relfreq, cumulative_ppt)

saveRDS(mandarin_functionword_relfreq, file.path(mandarin_data_dir, "mandarin_functionword_relfreq.RDS"))
```

# Plot and Fit Growth Curves

Plots speaker-level negation rates and fits Bayesian Gompertz curves to child `pct` and `cumulative_ppt` trajectories. Produces fitted child data and lag summaries for onset comparisons.

## Overall Negation

Plots monthly `pct` from `mandarin_negation_relfreq` by `speaker` and fits `mandarin_negation_lagModel` to child values. Saves `mandarin_negation_childdata` with `predictions` and displays the fitted curve.

```{r negation_overall_plot}
mandarin_negation_overall_plot <-
  mandarin_negation_relfreq %>%
  ggplot(aes(age, pct)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(. ~ speaker) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Age (Months)") + ylab("Monthly Percent of Tokens") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14))

mandarin_negation_overall_plot
```

```{r negation_overall_growth_model, include=FALSE}
mandarin_negation_lagModel <- brm(
  bf(pct ~ upperAsymptote * exp(-exp(((growthRate*exp(1))/upperAsymptote)*(lag-age)+1)),
     upperAsymptote ~ 1,
     growthRate ~ 1,
     lag ~ 1,
     nl = TRUE),
  data = filter(mandarin_negation_relfreq, speaker == "child"),
  prior = c(
    prior(uniform(0, 100), nlpar = "upperAsymptote", lb = 0, ub = 100),
    prior(uniform(0, 10), nlpar = "growthRate", lb = 0, ub = 10),
    prior(uniform(10, 72), nlpar = "lag", lb = 10, ub = 72)
  ),
  file = file.path(mandarin_model_dir, "mandarin_negation_lagModel"),
  file_refit = "on_change",
  iter = 10000)
```

```{r negation_overall_predictions}
mandarin_negation_childdata <- filter(mandarin_negation_relfreq, speaker == "child")
mandarin_negation_childdata$predictions <- fitted(mandarin_negation_lagModel)[, "Estimate"]

saveRDS(mandarin_negation_childdata, file.path(mandarin_data_dir, "mandarin_negation_childdata.RDS"))
```

```{r negation_overall_prediction_plot}
mandarin_negation_fit_plot <-
  ggplot(mandarin_negation_childdata, aes(x = age, y = pct)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = predictions), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Negation", x = "Child Age (Month)", y = "Monthly Percent of Tokens") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )

mandarin_negation_fit_plot
```

## Individual Negators

Plots `cumulative_ppt` for `不` and `没` by `speaker` and fits child Gompertz curves. Saves fitted child tables and model objects for the word onset comparison.

### 不 bù

Plots `cumulative_ppt` for `不` and fits `mandarin_bu_lagModel` to child data. Saves `mandarin_bu_childdata` with `predictions` and records the model lag summary.

```{r bu_plot, echo=FALSE}
mandarin_functionword_relfreq %>%
  filter(word=="不") %>%
  ggplot(aes(age, cumulative_ppt)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(.~speaker) +
  theme_bw() + 
  ggtitle("不 bù") +
  xlab("Age (Months)") + ylab("Cumulative Occurrences per 1,000 Tokens")
```

```{r bu_growth_model, include=FALSE}
mandarin_bu_lagModel <- brm(
  bf(cumulative_ppt  ~ upperAsymptote * exp(-exp(((growthRate*exp(1))/upperAsymptote)*(lag-age)+1)),
     upperAsymptote ~ 1,
     growthRate ~ 1,
     lag ~ 1,
     nl = TRUE),
  data = filter(mandarin_functionword_relfreq, word=="不", speaker=="child"),
  prior = c(
    prior(uniform(0, 40), nlpar = "upperAsymptote", lb = 0, ub = 40),
    prior(uniform(0, 10), nlpar = "growthRate", lb = 0, ub = 10),
    prior(uniform(10, 72), nlpar = "lag", lb = 10, ub = 72)
  ),
  file = file.path(mandarin_model_dir, "mandarin_bu_lagModel"),
  file_refit = "on_change",
  iter = 10000,
  seed = 16)
```

```{r bu_predictions}
mandarin_bu_predictions <- as.data.frame(fitted(mandarin_bu_lagModel))

mandarin_bu_childdata <- filter(mandarin_functionword_relfreq, word=="不", speaker=="child")
mandarin_bu_childdata$predictions <- mandarin_bu_predictions[, "Estimate"]

saveRDS(mandarin_bu_childdata, file.path(mandarin_data_dir, "mandarin_bu_childdata.RDS"))
```

```{r bu_age_of_production}
mandarin_bu_age_of_production <- data.frame(word = c("不 bù"), 
           Estimate = c(round(fixef(mandarin_bu_lagModel)[3,1],1)),

           )
```


## Sentential and Discourse Negation

Calculates scope-specific `cumulative_ppt` and fits child Gompertz curves by `negation_scope` and `negation_category`. Saves fitted child tables and scope onset summaries.

### Calculate Scope Rates

Calculates `cumulative_ppt` by `negation_scope` and `negation_category` from `mandarin_negator_tokens` against `mandarin_child_age_totals`. Saves `mandarin_negation_scope_relfreq`.

```{r negation_scope_data, include=FALSE}
mandarin_negation_words <- c("不", "没")
mandarin_negation_labels <- c("不 bù", "没 méi")
mandarin_negation_model_names <- c("不" = "bu", "没" = "mei")
mandarin_negation_asymptotes <- c("不" = 40, "没" = 20)

# Child word tokens per month (ages 0-10 are already zero).
mandarin_child_age_totals <- mandarin_speaker_age_totals %>%
  filter(speaker == "child") %>%
  select(age, total) %>%
  arrange(age)

# Each negator takes the type of its utterance; mixed utterances are left out.
mandarin_scope_counts <- mandarin_negator_tokens %>%
  filter(speaker == "child", negation_scope %in% c("sentential", "discourse")) %>%
  count(negation_scope, negation_category = word, age, name = "freq")

mandarin_negation_scope_relfreq <- tidyr::crossing(
  negation_scope = c("sentential", "discourse"),
  negation_category = mandarin_negation_words,
  mandarin_child_age_totals
) %>%
  left_join(
    mandarin_scope_counts,
    by = c("negation_scope", "negation_category", "age")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    speaker = "child",
    freq = replace_na(freq, 0L),
    freq = if_else(age <= 10, 0L, freq),
    relfreq = if_else(total == 0, 0, freq / total),
    ppt = relfreq * 1000
  ) %>%
  filter(freq > 0 | age %in% 0:10) %>%
  group_by(negation_scope, negation_category) %>%
  arrange(age, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_freq = cumsum(freq),
    cum_total = cumsum(total),
    cumulative_relfreq = if_else(cum_total == 0, 0, cum_freq / cum_total),
    cumulative_ppt = cumulative_relfreq * 1000
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

mandarin_sentential_negation_childdata <- mandarin_negation_scope_relfreq %>%
  filter(negation_scope == "sentential")

mandarin_discourse_negation_childdata <- mandarin_negation_scope_relfreq %>%
  filter(negation_scope == "discourse")

saveRDS(
  mandarin_negation_scope_relfreq,
  file.path(mandarin_data_dir, "mandarin_negation_scope_relfreq.RDS")
)
```

### Fit Scope Curves

Fits Gompertz curves to scope series with positive `cumulative_ppt` and saves `mandarin_sentential_negation_childdata` and `mandarin_discourse_negation_childdata` with `predictions`.

```{r negation_scope_curve_data, include=FALSE}
# Use the same per-word asymptote limits as the individual Mandarin models.
mandarin_fit_scope_growth <- function(scope_data, scope_name) {
  if (nrow(scope_data) == 0L ||
      !all(scope_data$negation_category %in% mandarin_negation_words)) {
    stop("Invalid Mandarin scope data. Run negation_scope_data first.")
  }

  purrr::map_dfr(mandarin_negation_words, function(w) {
    word_data <- scope_data %>%
      filter(
        negation_category == w,
        is.finite(age),
        is.finite(cumulative_ppt)
      ) %>%
      arrange(age)

    word_data$predictions <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(word_data))

    # Keep observed zeros, without fitting a model to an all-zero series.
    if (nrow(word_data) == 0L || !any(word_data$cumulative_ppt > 0)) {
      return(word_data)
    }

    asymptote <- mandarin_negation_asymptotes[[w]]
    model <- brms::brm(
      brms::bf(
        cumulative_ppt ~ upperAsymptote *
          exp(-exp(((growthRate * exp(1)) / upperAsymptote) * (lag - age) + 1)),
        upperAsymptote ~ 1,
        growthRate ~ 1,
        lag ~ 1,
        nl = TRUE
      ),
      data = word_data,
      prior = c(
        brms::set_prior(
          sprintf("uniform(0, %s)", asymptote),
          nlpar = "upperAsymptote", lb = 0, ub = asymptote
        ),
        brms::set_prior("uniform(0, 10)", nlpar = "growthRate", lb = 0, ub = 10),
        brms::set_prior("uniform(10, 72)", nlpar = "lag", lb = 10, ub = 72)
      ),
      # A Mandarin prefix also separates these caches from the older scope fits.
      file = file.path(
        mandarin_model_dir,
        paste0(
          "mandarin_", mandarin_negation_model_names[[w]], "_",
          scope_name, "_lagModel"
        )
      ),
      file_refit = "on_change",
      iter = 10000,
      seed = 1234
    )

    word_data$predictions <- fitted(model, newdata = word_data)[, "Estimate"]
    word_data
  })
}

mandarin_sentential_negation_childdata <- mandarin_fit_scope_growth(
  mandarin_sentential_negation_childdata, "sentential"
)

mandarin_discourse_negation_childdata <- mandarin_fit_scope_growth(
  mandarin_discourse_negation_childdata, "discourse"
)

saveRDS(
  mandarin_sentential_negation_childdata,
  file.path(mandarin_data_dir, "mandarin_sentential_negation_childdata.RDS")
)

saveRDS(
  mandarin_discourse_negation_childdata,
  file.path(mandarin_data_dir, "mandarin_discourse_negation_childdata.RDS")
)

mandarin_plot_child_negation <- function(plot_data, plot_title) {
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0L ||
      !all(plot_data$negation_category %in% mandarin_negation_words)) {
    stop("Invalid Mandarin plotting data. Rebuild the Mandarin scope tables first.")
  }

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = age, y = cumulative_ppt)) +
    geom_point(color = "black", size = 2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = predictions), color = "blue", linewidth = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ negation_category,
      ncol = 2,
      scales = "free_y",
      labeller = as_labeller(
        setNames(mandarin_negation_labels, mandarin_negation_words)
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, 12)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = "Child Age (Months)",
      y = "Cumulative Occurrences per 1,000 Tokens"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}
```

### Estimate Scope Onsets

Extracts `lag_Intercept` and 95% credible intervals from fitted scope models into `mandarin_negation_scope_age_of_production`. Saves the scope onset table as RDS.

```{r scope_age_of_production}
extract_scope_onsets <- function(scope_data, scope_name) {

  # Include only word/scope pairs with fitted curves.
  fitted_words <- scope_data %>%
    filter(is.finite(predictions)) %>%
    distinct(negation_category) %>%
    pull(negation_category)

  purrr::map_dfr(fitted_words, function(w) {

    model_path <- file.path(
      mandarin_model_dir,
      paste0(
        "mandarin_", mandarin_negation_model_names[[w]],
        "_", scope_name, "_lagModel.rds"
      )
    )

    if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
      stop("Missing scope model: ", model_path)
    }

    model <- readRDS(model_path)
    model_summary <- brms::fixef(model)

    if (!"lag_Intercept" %in% rownames(model_summary)) {
      stop("Cannot find lag_Intercept in: ", model_path)
    }

    lag_summary <- model_summary["lag_Intercept", ]

    tibble(
      language = "Mandarin",
      category = stringr::str_to_title(scope_name),
      word = mandarin_negation_labels[
        match(w, mandarin_negation_words)
      ],
      Estimate = unname(lag_summary["Estimate"]),
      Est.Error = unname(lag_summary["Est.Error"]),
      Q2.5 = unname(lag_summary["Q2.5"]),
      Q97.5 = unname(lag_summary["Q97.5"])
    )
  })
}

mandarin_negation_scope_age_of_production <- bind_rows(
  extract_scope_onsets(
    mandarin_sentential_negation_childdata,
    "sentential"
  ),
  extract_scope_onsets(
    mandarin_discourse_negation_childdata,
    "discourse"
  )
)

if (nrow(mandarin_negation_scope_age_of_production) == 0L) {
  stop("No fitted scope models available. Run the scope-model chunks first.")
}

saveRDS(
  mandarin_negation_scope_age_of_production,
  file.path(
    mandarin_data_dir,
    "mandarin_negation_scope_age_of_production.RDS"
  )
)
```


### Plot Scope Onsets

Plots `mandarin_negation_scope_age_of_production` lag estimates and 95% credible intervals separately for sentential and discourse categories. Saves `mandarin_sentential_negation_onset_plot` and `mandarin_discourse_negation_onset_plot` as RDS.

```{r categorize_onset}
plot_scope_onset <- function(category_name) {

  mandarin_negation_scope_age_of_production %>%
    filter(category == category_name) %>%
    mutate(word = forcats::fct_reorder(word, Estimate)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = word)) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, by = 6)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 72)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Mandarin", category_name, "Negation"),
      x = "Fitted lag (months)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12)
}

# Create the two plot objects.
mandarin_sentential_negation_onset_plot <-
  plot_scope_onset("Sentential")

mandarin_discourse_negation_onset_plot <-
  plot_scope_onset("Discourse")


# Save the plot objects for reuse in R.
saveRDS(
  mandarin_sentential_negation_onset_plot,
  file.path(
    mandarin_data_dir,
    "mandarin_sentential_negation_onset_plot.RDS"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  mandarin_discourse_negation_onset_plot,
  file.path(
    mandarin_data_dir,
    "mandarin_discourse_negation_onset_plot.RDS"
  )
)

# Display both graphs in the knitted document.
mandarin_sentential_negation_onset_plot
mandarin_discourse_negation_onset_plot
```

# Word Onset Estimates

Combines `mandarin_bu_age_of_production` and `mandarin_mei_age_of_production` into `mandarin_age_of_production` and plots lag estimates with 95% credible intervals. Interprets these values as fitted lag parameters rather than observed first-production ages.

```{r age_of_production_build}
mandarin_age_of_production <- bind_rows(
  mandarin_bu_age_of_production,
  mandarin_mei_age_of_production
) %>%
  mutate(word = fct_reorder(word, Estimate))

saveRDS(mandarin_age_of_production, file.path(mandarin_data_dir, "mandarin_age_of_production.RDS"))
```

```{r age_of_production_plot}
mandarin_functionword_onsetage_plot <-
  mandarin_age_of_production %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = word)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5)) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, by = 6)) +
  labs(x = "Age (Months)", y = "") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12))

mandarin_functionword_onsetage_plot
```
